title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Build weekly campaign dashboards in Excel and SQL for our marketing team. Clean survey and ad-platform exports, flag anomalies, and present findings in a short Friday readout.

Requirements: coursework in statistics or business analytics, comfort with spreadsheets. 15 hours per week during the semester. Pay is $19 per hour, paid biweekly through payroll.

title: Front Desk Assistant
description:
Greet patients, confirm appointments, answer the phone and keep the waiting area organized. Evenings and Saturdays. Training provided by our office manager.

Pay: $16 per hour. Please apply through our practice website.

title: Research Assistant, Survey Data
description:
Help a small policy lab code open-ended survey responses and check them for consistency. You will work in a shared spreadsheet and meet with your supervisor once a week over video.

10 hours per week, $17 per hour. Applicants should be enrolled students with strong attention to detail.

title: Warehouse Associate
description: Load and unload trucks, scan inbound pallets and keep aisles clear. Must be able to lift 50 lbs. Weekend shifts, 12 to 20 hours per week. $17.50 per hour.

title: Remote Admin Assistant
description: Work from home on your own schedule. No experience needed and pay is $32 per hour. We hire immediately and interview by text message on Telegram, so you could start today. Reply now because spots fill fast.

findings.title: Pushed onto a messaging app
findings.why: Moving to an unmonitored app right away avoids platform fraud detection and leaves no record.

findings.title: Interview by text only
findings.why: Scam operations avoid live video because they're using a stolen or invented identity.

findings.title: High pay for very little
findings.why: Pay well above market for a role needing no experience is bait, not an opportunity.

findings.title: Pressure to decide now
findings.why: Urgency is there to stop you checking. Real hiring runs on weeks, not hours.

title: Payments Processing Assistant
description: Earn $950 per week from home. We will mail you a check to deposit; keep your share and send the rest via gift cards for equipment. No experience needed. Text our manager on Telegram to start today.

findings.title: The job involves moving money or packages
findings.why: Depositing checks and forwarding funds, or reshipping parcels, is how stolen money and goods get laundered.

findings.title: Payment through irreversible channels
findings.why: Gift cards, crypto, and peer-to-peer apps can't be reversed or traced. No payroll uses them.

title: Sales Lead Specialist

findings.title: Looks like an aggregator or lead-generation listing
